summary_1line: Sarmishtha secretly bears Yayati’s son and deceives Devayani, whose later discovery through the children exposes the hidden relationship.

image_candidates.scene_text: Three radiant children in the forest point toward King Yayati as their father while Devayani watches in stunned realization.
The boys run to clasp Yayati’s knees, but the king stands frozen and refuses to embrace them before Devayani.
Sarmishtha, calm and defiant, explains her actions to the angry Devayani in the palace garden.
